claims.evidence: All 280 .raw files in the PRIDE list are claimed once; MaxQuant summary.txt lists exactly the same 280 raw-file names. txtproteome.zip (SEARCH) not a data file.

claims.location: source name / characteristics[biological replicate] / factor value[cell line]
claims.evidence: MaxQuant Experiment column assigns every raw file to Hep2_R1..R3 or Jurkat_R1..R3, consistent with file-name tokens. Replicates treated as biological replicates by inference (paper not readable).
MaxQuant Fraction column; equals file-name suffix for every file.

MaxQuant assigns these 4 files to experiment Hep2_R3 fractions 41-44, duplicating 20160211 Hep2_R3 F41-44; RAW headers confirm original names and later acquisition. Fraction set by documented post-processing.
PRIDE organism NEWT:9606; both Cellosaurus records NCBI_TaxID 9606; MeSH Humans.

claims.evidence: PRIDE organismParts BTO Hep-2 cell / Jurkat cell; run names Hep2/Jurkat; MeSH Jurkat Cells. Jurkat clone not documented (parental record used).

Cultured cell lines; tissue of origin recorded in sampling site instead.
Not stated in PRIDE record; paper full text unavailable.
PRIDE instruments field; RAW headers of QE5 and QE3 runs read 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS'.

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], [dissociation method], [collision energy], [ms2 mass analyzer]
claims.value: DDA PRIDE:0000627; HCD MS:1000422; 28 NCE; orbitrap MS:1000484
claims.evidence: Method sections of 4 RAW files: TopN 20, HCD NCE 28, MS2 resolution 15,000 (Orbitrap).

PRIDE sample protocol: lysate digested with Lys-C, subsequent trypsin digestion; MaxQuant proteome search Trypsin/P; peptide C-termini 3637 K / 3490 R in first 7206 peptides. Lys-C for the proteome is inferred from the shared lysate protocol.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Acetyl Protein N-term, Gln->pyro-Glu, Deamidated N/Q, Phospho S/T variable
claims.evidence: summary.txt Fixed/Variable modifications and Multi modifications columns, identical for all 280 files.
MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm; MS2 in Orbitrap.
Not recorded in deposited MaxQuant 1.5.3 parameters.txt/summary.txt; no mqpar.xml.

PRIDE sample protocol (CAA) and the cited Bekker-Jensen 2017 workflow both use chloroacetamide, consistent with fixed Carbamidomethyl (C). Reduction set to not available after independent review: the PRIDE protocol (DTT) is shared with the UbiSite deposit, while the cited deep-proteome workflow uses TCEP.
PRIDE protocol: proteome peptides fractionated by offline high-pH RP; 46 fractions per sample.

limitations: Paper (Nat Struct Mol Biol 2018, PMID 29967540) not open access; only abstract and MeSH used.
R1-R3 interpreted as biological replicates from file/experiment names only.
No treatment documented for the proteome runs; no treatment column written.
Jurkat clone (parental vs E6-1) not documented.

Lys-C pre-digestion and CAA alkylation for the proteome are supported by both the PRIDE UbiSite protocol and the cited Bekker-Jensen 2017 workflow; the reduction reagent conflicts (DTT vs TCEP) and is recorded as not available.
Instrument method checked on 4 of 280 RAW files.
Precursor mass tolerance not recoverable from deposited files.
sdrf-tools reconcile reports cleavage_agent_incomplete because it reads only the first repeated cleavage column; Trypsin is present in the second.
